messages:
Jordan Scott: FYI team — offer ready for candidate Jordan Park (SWE) based in Germany. Hiring manager asked for a geo-based adjustment and to keep the sign‑on bonus. Looking to start around 2026-09-18. Who needs to approve the compband exception and tax-eq?
Aisha Khan: +1 from me for a 10% geo bump given Berlin market. Manager also proposed 90% base for first 3 months probation then full band. Start 9/20 would be easier for ramp but candidate prefers 9/18.
Carlos Mendez: @Aisha + @Jordan we need to run payroll impact and EU tax equalization note. Payroll setup for DE takes ~2 weeks — that'll affect start if not prepped. I can run a quick delta: `delta = base * 0.10` and include bonus amortization.
People Ops Bot: Offer form submitted by Jordan Scott — ID: OFR-2026-1192. Attachments: resume, passport, proposed offer PDF.
Maya Rivera: @Jordan thanks. Please attach the candidate's German work authorization and confirm remote city. I'll route a compband exception to the committee and loop Legal for DE payroll guidance. Also need confirmation if sign-on bonus is payout in USD or EUR.
Jordan Scott: Uploaded passport and work auth. Candidate confirmed Berlin, wants bonus in EUR. Manager confirmed they will honor full sign-on if comp committee ok.
Maya Rivera: Routing to comp-committee now. Tagging @Liam Patel for exec approval if committee recommends above-band adjustment. Carlos, can you post a quick cost summary in this thread when ready?
Carlos Mendez: Will do. Preliminary: base 120k USD equiv -> bump 10% = +12k; sign-on 15k EUR paid up front. Total first-year delta ~ +27k USD equiv (w/ payroll taxes). I'll send a short spreadsheet by EOD.
Liam Patel: Sounds reasonable from my side pending final numbers and Legal’s DE note. Please highlight any long-term compband implications. :thumbsup:
Maya Rivera: Thanks all — I'll update once comp-committee meets. If committee approves, People Ops will route final offer packet and escalate to payroll for DE setup.
Jordan Scott: Appreciate it — will keep candidate updated (asked to hold for 48h).
